messages:
Alice Kim: Hey folks — HeliosHealth's SI ran into a blocker on the AWS Marketplace onboarding. Image ingest is failing at attest time: marketplace scan reports a GPG signature mismatch and the partner's artifact repo is in a private VPC so they can't push to our staging account. Can someone own coordination with Marketplace PM + the partner SE? cc @Dan Zhou for network/egress constraints.

Mateo Rivera: I can take point on the attestation flow. Can you paste the exact error/log? Also who is the partner SE so I can loop them in?

Alice Kim: Pasting the ingest error we got from their SI:

```
ERROR: marketplace-attestation: signature invalid (key id 0xABCD1234)
ingest rejected: attestation verification failed
registry: https://artifactory.partnercorp.internal
```

Partner SE is Aaron Lim (external) — I'll include him in the invite but keep internal convo here.

Priya Patel: For implementation: is the problem the signature itself, or the marketplace hash not matching due to mutating layers during partner build? If it's the latter we can offer a rebuild in our CI and push a signed image. That requires partner CI creds and a legal attestation doc.

Dan Zhou: FYI we can't do VPC peering with partner infra for marketplace ingestion. Options: 1) partner pushes to a public registry we control (S3 presigned upload or ECR) 2) we re-build the image from their published artifact source and sign it ourselves 3) marketplace has an attestation bypass for known legacy keys (requires PM/legal sign-off). See internal onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/onboard (private).

Mateo Rivera: Quick technical note — the key id in the error (0xABCD1234) looks like an old key we saw in another partner case last quarter. I'll check our keyring map. If it's an expired/rotated key we can accept if partner provides signed commit with key rotation statement, but that's a policy exception. Otherwise rebuild is cleaner.

deploy-bot: Marketplace ingest job failed: job_id=mp-ingest-9802 status=REJECTED timestamp=2026-03-20T15:02:11Z reason="attestation:signature_invalid"

Priya Patel: I can coordinate the SI for a rebuild (we have a small runbook). Need these from partner: CI pipeline access token (scoped), Dockerfile + exact base image digest, and confirmation they consent to Redwood rebuild. Also legal will need the attestation form filled if we sign for them.

Alice Kim: OK plan: Mateo + Dan own the technical & marketplace-side followups, Priya will handle SI/rebuild logistics with the partner. I'll schedule an architecture review with the partner + Marketplace PM tomorrow 10:00am PST. I'll pull Legal on the calendar invite for attestation path.

Dan Zhou: I'll open INC-8421 to track the marketplace attestation exception path and ping Jasper (Marketplace PM).

Mateo Rivera: I'll audit the keychain and confirm whether 0xABCD1234 is whitelisted/rotated, and post findings here before the call.

Priya Patel: I'll draft the SI checklist and share in this thread. If partner can provide a time window for CI creds, we can aim to do a rebuild same day after the meeting. :+1:

Alice Kim: Thanks team — moving to action items. Mateo (attestation/key), Dan (PM/ticket), Priya (SI checklist), me (invite + partner comms). Adding Aaron Lim to the thread via DM and will copy any vendor replies into this channel.

(Added note) Alice Kim: calendar invite sent: "HeliosHealth Marketplace attestation & onboarding — arch review" 2026-03-21 10:00 PST.

Mateo Rivera: Seen, added.

Priya Patel: Seen, will prep checklist.
